authority: Owner ruling G-R10: complete ParameterBlock, preregister README/topic searches before running, retain every repository already found, and explicitly disclose the incomplete shader-attribute route. NP-Q5 still prohibits implementation.
boundary_in_plain_words: The candidate set is the retained r2 set and all prior discoveries, the complete size-partitioned ParameterBlock code search, and the complete README/topic repository queries below. The shader-attribute code route is incomplete: it reported39040 files and only the recorded pages were read under a10requests/minute limit. No claim to cover every Slang project or every project with100stars follows.
reach: For each repository query append a stars: range covering at least100stars. Query-hit stars are captured at search time; later star drift does not remove a captured candidate. Code-only discoveries use their recorded metadata star count; all previously found repositories remain visible, with below-reach dispositions as applicable. All18 named seeds and all22 previously verified new eligible projects (sixnvpro plus16additional) remain in the candidate set at their frozen pins.

pagination_protocol.split: If total_count>100 split the inclusive star range at floor((lo+hi)/2), lower half first. If an exact star value still has>100 matches, split by inclusive created date range1970-01-01..2100-12-31, at integer day midpoint, using created:lo..hi. If an exact star/day still exceeds100, stop incomplete; no ranked truncation or new partition without a dated amendment.
pagination_protocol.certify: A leaf is complete only when HTTP200, incomplete_results=false, total_count<=100, len(items)==total_count, unique repository IDs and public-only items. Each leaf is one page; source-index and star movements can produce cross-leaf duplicates, which are unioned rather than dropped.
pagination_protocol.errors: Honor rate resets. Preserve error responses and retry identical requests at most three attempts; uncertified leaves block freeze. Record every exact request/range/status/hash/count and repository identity, never source content or people.

candidate_union: Union complete ParameterBlock repository identities, all completed repository-query leaves, all18 named seeds, the retained18 r2 rows, and every public repository observed in r3/r3a attempts including incomplete shader-attribute pages. Every identity has one disposition and all discovery sources; duplicates never remove a project. Preserve already pinned metadata; newly discovered projects use the inherited latest-public-release or full-HEAD rule before tree/license evaluation.
eligibility: Inherit whole-project exact lowercase.slang/.slangh regular files, duplicate occurrences retained, OSI root grant, selected-files1..5000 and selected-bytes<=50000000, GPU Slang language proof from pinned primary docs/build metadata, diagnostic compiler role, explicit zero/license/wrong-language/size/below-reach dispositions. Ambiguous/unretrievable candidates stop freeze. No parser/compiler result may affect membership.
holdout: Re-derive largest eligible whole-project holdout from the completed union, tie by repository identity. Retain all its selected files outside primary/canonical aggregation; report blob overlap rather than deduplicate. Primary and holdout separately must meet5% ERROR-or-MISSING and0.1% faults; the weaker result caps any future level or change note. All rates remain unmeasured.
required_disclosure: Assessment and any ceiling repeat this search boundary in plain words, including shader-attribute total_count39040,10requests/minute and the actual pages read. The scope is a bounded candidate search, not reach-complete or an atomic GitHub snapshot. Inherited r3 registry-followup wording is historical; the User-Agent retry has already completed and the403 cause is recorded as missing header.
freeze_order: Commit this dated rule BEFORE executing any of these README/topic repository requests. Complete ParameterBlock and every leaf of these four repository queries, dispose the entire union and bind source hashes before re-freezing. No Slang shader-body download, parsing, native/compiler execution, oracle run, level or product implementation is authorized.
